Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly hypothesized that the "status" of the religious building (the Baptistery) was related to its inclusion in the "UNESCO World Heritage Site" status of the Historic Centre of Florence. This was a premature assumption based on the general location of the Duomo complex. The Planner failed to verify the specific ecclesiastical title of the Baptistery itself. While the building is indeed part of a UNESCO site, its specific *official status* as a religious building is "Minor Basilica," a fact explicitly found in the search results (e.g., from tour.florence.it) that the Planner initially overlooked or dismissed in favor of the UNESCO angle, leading to a failure to identify the correct answer ("a minor basilica") in the first few steps.
